non_claims: This repair does not constitute a canonical graph mutation.

repair_cause: Multiple atlas register-phase-files CLI processes were run concurrently against out/genesis_base_graph_v0.4_unified.lmdb. The row stores accepted writes, but the derived graph payload and secondary indexes fell out of sync.
repair_method: Loaded the full node and edge row stores via GenesisAtlasCandidateStore.iter_nodes() and iter_edges(), then rebuilt derived stores with replace_nodes(), replace_edges(), and put_graph_payload(). Subsequent phase-file registrations were run sequentially.
repair_record_location_note: This committed docs receipt is the durable provenance record. The ignored out/ tree may contain local CLI receipts, but out/ is not used as the committed evidence surface.
